command:
set -euo pipefail
root=$(mktemp -d)
runtime=$(mktemp -d)
out=$(mktemp)
err=$(mktemp)
XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$runtime" node bin/cartographer-dashboard.js start --root "$root" --host 127.0.0.1 --port 0 --json >"$out" 2>"$err" &
server_pid=$!
cleanup() {
  XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$runtime" node bin/cartographer-dashboard.js stop --root "$root" --json >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  if kill -0 "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null; then kill "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT
for _ in $(seq 1 80); do
  if [ -s "$out" ]; then break; fi
  if ! kill -0 "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null; then echo "server exited early" >&2; cat "$err" >&2; exit 1; fi
  sleep 0.1
done
[ -s "$out" ] || { echo "no start output" >&2; cat "$err" >&2; exit 1; }
node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8")); if(!p.ok||p.command!=="start"||p.status!=="running"||p.mode!=="read-only") throw new Error("bad start payload"); if(!p.url.startsWith("http://127.0.0.1:")) throw new Error("bad url"); if(!p.metadataPath.startsWith(process.argv[2])) throw new Error("metadata outside runtime dir"); if(p.metadataPath.includes(".plan")) throw new Error("metadata under .plan"); console.log(p.url);' "$out" "$runtime"
XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$runtime" node bin/cartographer-dashboard.js status --root "$root" --json | node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0,"utf8")); if(!p.ok||p.status!=="running") throw new Error("bad status payload"); console.log("status ok");'
XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$runtime" node bin/cartographer-dashboard.js stop --root "$root" --json | node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0,"utf8")); if(!p.ok||p.status!=="stopped"||!p.stopped) throw new Error("bad stop payload"); console.log("stop ok");'
wait "$server_pid"
